_provenance.source: OpenStreetMap Overpass API: ways 1321868105, 1321868106, 150227745 (Eightmile Lake Trail #1552) and 328892288, 1031032616 (Eightmile-Trout Creek Trail #1554), stitched by shared node id; the path from the trailhead node to each end found by Dijkstra over great-circle edge lengths (a tree, so the only path). Lakes are OSM water polygons by centroid, projected onto the nearest vertex. Retrieved 2026-09-25.
_provenance.note: routeKm and measuredKm are the same computed distance along this line from the Eightmile Trailhead: no marker posts here, as on the traverse. officialLengthKm equals the measured line; the Forest Service gives no end-to-end figure for these lines (its pages say Eightmile Lake is "a little more than 3 miles" and #1554 "begins about 2.8 miles up" #1552; Eightmile Lake Trail page last updated June 3, 2026, Eightmile-Trout Creek page June 12, 2026). Elevation: srtm30m@opentopodata, fetched 2026-09-25. A DEM is not a survey.
